task: Add a separate artifact release provenance ledger for non-runtime DONE artifacts without expanding CLI patch-version bump rules.
outcome: After a story like B-fe25 reaches DONE, the terminal shows an artifact release record with story id, main commit, changed artifact paths, and artifactSetDigest; running lattice artifact_release_list --format=json or lattice artifact_release_status --storyId=<story> shows the same provenance even though the CLI package version did not increase.
facts: Commit d3d8b3b83 changed non-runtime experiment/protocol artifacts and correctly skipped CLI patch semver because packages/main runtime inputs did not change.
done-effects.ts already computes DONE merge changed paths after merging the story branch to main.
version-bump-smoke currently asserts experiments/** does not trigger the CLI semver bump, and that behavior must remain true.
docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md already states CLI patch version is not a repository-wide artifact ledger.
Command registration should sit with other artifact/evidence workflow commands, near artifact_declare/evidence_manifest.
The ledger storage path will be project-level .lattice/artifact-releases.jsonl, outside per-story lifecycle metadata.
constraints: Do not broaden CLI patch-version bump policy to arbitrary docs, experiments, or story metadata.
Do not treat .lattice story lifecycle metadata as product artifact release contents.
Records must be deterministic/idempotent for the same story, commit, and artifact digest.
Inspection commands must be host-neutral read-only workflow commands, not Codex-specific commands.
